as_told.title: Epstein's Zorro Ranch near retired Los Alamos physicists

plain: Jeffrey Epstein is said to have set up his New Mexico estate, Zorro Ranch, on purpose to be near physicists retiring from the Los Alamos nuclear weapons laboratory, and Michels takes this as a sign of how loose Department of Energy security was. Michels tells it himself on several episodes, sourcing it to Steve Bannon's taped interview with Epstein, which he places near the end of Epstein's life in 2019, where Epstein supposedly told Bannon why he chose the spot; the story dates the move to 1993, though one of Michels's tellings gives no year.
